archiveTitle: Daily Brief | DAVE THE DIVER reveals final crossover DLC

entries.headline: DAVE THE DIVER reveals final DLC with a Subnautica 2 crossover
entries.summary: MINTROCKET reveals DAVE THE DIVER's final DLC, taking the adventure into Subnautica 2's alien ocean with a release planned for early 2027.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON, Famitsu and Denfaminicogamer report the same showcase announcement. Timing uses the conservative wording early 2027.
entries.timeNote: Source published at 2026-10-09 00:52 Beijing time, within the edition's fixed window.
